headline: Reviewed Section J school policies, passing several and placing others on hold for further review.
summary: The Policy Subcommittee reviewed and acted on a list of Section J policies, passing some, removing or relocating others, and holding several for further legal, administrative, or curriculum review. Members also discussed parental contact information opt-in and set a fall schedule meeting for September 11 at 12 pm.
decisions: Put policy JICJ on hold for more review on a technology loophole.
Put policy JICK on hold for admin review.
Put policy JIH on hold for legal review on backpack searches.
Relocated policy JJ-R to the handbook.
Put policy JJA on hold for curriculum language review.

decision_evidence.quote: JICJ: HOLD for more review specifically loophole on not using technology in Schools
JIH: Hold for legal review on backpack searches
